verdict.rationale: Intel's Gaudi docs cover LLM inference: PyTorch inference, serving through vLLM and SGLang, model serving, and quantized models in FP8 or INT4. The evidence is only section titles, and FP4 is not shown (INT4 is listed instead), so this does not fully cover the story as written. missing for 10: documented FP4 support, depth beyond doc section headings (which models, limits, performance of the FP8 and vLLM paths), any hands-on or independent confirmation that the vLLM/FP8 inference path works on Gaudi 3.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, this GPU has a documented LLM inference story — low-precision formats (FP8/FP4) and supported serving stacks (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, llama.cpp) for this part
